issuer_resolution.resolved_issuer: Victor Elementary School District (San Bernardino County, California)
issuer_resolution.resolved_security: Election of 2008 General Obligation Bonds, Series C, Current Interest Bonds
issuer_resolution.authority: EMMA Security Details header + Final Official Statement cover page (raw/official_statement.pdf p.1)
issuer_resolution.finding: VERIFIED - CDE fuzzy match was CORRECT. Issuer is Victor Elementary SD, NOT Victor Valley Union HSD nor City of Victorville. Those are distinct OVERLAPPING entities (Victor Valley UHSD = 56.462% applicable in the OS direct&overlapping table; a separate issuer family, likely the 926055 prefix).
issuer_resolution.screens_attribution: Screens were attributed to the CORRECT district; no re-run required.

verifications.method: OS cover + Security and Sources of Payment section
verifications.authority: official_statement.pdf p.1, l.24; THE BONDS section
verifications.finding: VERIFIED - County obligated to levy ad valorem taxes without limitation as to rate or amount on all taxable property in the District.

verifications.claim: SB-222 / Gov Code 53515 statutory first lien
verifications.finding: VERIFIED - statutory lien attaches automatically on ad valorem tax revenues, valid and binding from delivery, enforceable against District and creditors.

verifications.method: OS Tax Matters + Bond Counsel opinion
verifications.finding: VERIFIED - excluded from federal gross income, NOT an AMT preference item, exempt from CA personal income tax. Double-exempt; TEY gross-up valid for CA resident.

verifications.method: OS AV history table + FYE2025 CD
verifications.finding: VERIFIED at issuance ($7.059B, 2018-19). AV grew ~5%/yr 2014-2019. Current 2024-25 AV not separately re-extracted but FYE2025 audit confirms ongoing operations.

verifications.method: OS Statement of Direct & Overlapping Debt
verifications.finding: VERIFIED - Direct debt 0.71% of AV; total direct+overlapping 2.57%; combined total 5.22%. Moderate-low for CA school GO.
VERIFIED at issuance (Aa3, Moody's). No subsequent rating-change event notice on EMMA = no downgrade flagged.

verifications.authority: CA Dept of Education AB-1200 interim certifications
verifications.finding: CONSISTENT - POSITIVE self-certification (can meet obligations current + 2 yrs). Corroborated by FYE2025 audit: Unmodified opinion, General Fund reserves 8.1% of outgo, no going-concern doubt.

verifications.method: OS Alternative Method of Tax Apportionment
verifications.finding: VERIFIED that San Bernardino County has implemented the Teeter Plan for the 1% general levy. UNVERIFIABLE whether County applies Teeter to the GO debt-service levy specifically (OS states this is at County option, not guaranteed). Flagged as a residual risk.

VERIFIED - 79 trades trailing-365d; 31 distinct trading days; 14 two-sided days (better than screen's recorded 7); two-way dealer flow (43 D / 17 P / 19 S); median trade $30k; last cust sale 98.475 / 4.12% YTW 2026-06-03.

verifications.authority: compute_bond_analytics.py; 4.12% YTW x ~2.01 CA double-exempt factor
verifications.finding: CONSISTENT - 4.12% gross YTW x 2.01 = ~8.28% TEY. NOTE: this is a gross-yield TEY, not net-of-fees and not a forward total return. YTW = YTM here (discount bond; 2028 call out-of-money).
VERIFIED - recomputed YTW 4.1198% vs EMMA 4.12% (delta 0.0002 pp, inside +/-0.003 tol). Mod duration to worst 12.6. EMMA YX = yield-to-WORST.
